ELV & IT Solutions

Extra Low Voltage (ELV) and IT solutions form the intelligent backbone of a modern building, covering structured cabling, network infrastructure, and connected systems that enable communication and automation across a facility. Our engineers design, install, and maintain this infrastructure to the standard the rest of your systems depend on
Security System AMC

Security hardware isn't install-and-forget — cameras drift, sensors wear, and credentials need ongoing management. Our Security System AMC covers scheduled maintenance and priority response across CCTV, access control, gate barriers, and alarms — one contract, one point of contact, instead of juggling separate arrangements for each system.
Compliance & Licensing

Security system installation and operation in the UAE is regulated by authorities including SIRA (Dubai) and ADMCC (Abu Dhabi), and working with a licensed, compliant contractor matters for both legal operation and insurance purposes. We manage the compliance side of every security installation, so your systems are installed and documented to meet the licensing requirements relevant to your emirate.For fire-related civil defence compliance and Istifa Certificate services, see our dedicated Civil Defence Compliance page.
Why Choose Firestone for Security & ELV

Firestone Fire and Security Systems has designed and installed security and ELV systems across the UAE since 2007, working alongside our fire protection services to give facilities a single contractor across life safety, security, and building infrastructure. Rather than specializing in just one product line, we handle the full range — from individual systems like CCTV or access control through to structured cabling and IT infrastructure — so a project doesn't need to be split across multiple contractors who each own a small piece of the building's overall security and connectivity.
Why Integrate Your Security and ELV Systems

Security and ELV systems installed separately, by different contractors at different times, often don't communicate with each other — a gate barrier that doesn't recognize an access control credential, a CCTV system with no link to the intrusion alarm, or IT infrastructure that wasn't planned around the security systems now running on it. We design these systems together from the start, so access control, CCTV, gate barriers, and the network backbone they all depend on work as one coordinated system rather than isolated installations that happen to share a building.
